claims.text: The threshold values are chosen to ensure a distribution of class labels of about 1:10, with distituents being the majority, reflecting linguistic principles.
The specific thresholds τ min as 0.0005 and τ max as 0.995 are set to classify outside strings as gold-standard constituents and distituents.
The choice of thresholds is informed by empirical evaluations from previous research, ensuring robustness in the model's performance.
